corrections.before: Differences among organisms arising from genetic recombination, mutation, development, and environmental context.
corrections.after: Differences in DNA sequences or chromosome content among cells or organisms. Mutation can originate variants, and recombination can create new combinations; environment and development also affect phenotypes without necessarily changing inherited DNA.

corrections.before: Two crossing-over events within the chromosome interval being studied.
corrections.after: Two or more crossing-over events within the chromosome interval being studied.
